Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Performing and Display
Topic 2.1: Rounds
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Rounds, part of Performing and Display in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do you perform a round song? 2. How do we make mats?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Rounds together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Responsibility: A learner displays diligence as they sing their own part in rounds.

● Unity: A learner shows cooperation as they collaborate with peers in singing their own part in rounds.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Life skills: A learner enhances confidentiality as they interact with peers during music clubs and societies when in school.

Link to other learning areas:

Language Activities: Learners apply the knowledge learnt in languages to write and read using appropriate writing equipment

such as braille machines, slates and stylers and large printed books to read and write the text of the round songs phrase by

phrase.

Open space, improvised instruments.
